opener_concept: £40 hoodie with 25% off, then a further loyalty 10% off at the till. Student subtracts by common sense (£10 off, then £3 off) and the reveal names it: keeping 75% then 90% is multiplying multipliers, which is all compound change is. Verified: 40x0.75=30, 30x0.9=27, and 35% off would be 26.
